shortDescription: Helps community legal centre staff record and triage legal enquiries under an approved profile.
longDescription: Creates a centre-approved triage profile and uses it to prepare provisional, staff-reviewed enquiry records. The plugin minimises client data, keeps conflict checking outside the model, escalates urgency and uncertainty, and never makes autonomous eligibility, merits or service decisions.
defaultPrompt: Configure a governed triage profile for this community legal centre.
Prepare a provisional staff-reviewed triage record for this enquiry.
Check whether this triage profile is approved and safe to use.
whatItDoes: Configures a centre-approved staff triage profile
Prepares provisional enquiry records with limited client information
boundaries: Conflict checks stay outside the model
Authorized staff make every consequential decision
